plainTranslation: Action and discipline cooperate. The Mars person supplies energy, the Saturn person supplies structure, and together they get real things done. One of the better contacts for a working partnership. Aim the drive at a concrete, long-term goal.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.

summaryDeep: Their discipline and your drive build well. Steady, productive effort together. This is a good working-partnership dynamic.
tension: The challenge is that caution can quietly turn into avoidance. You may find yourself endlessly preparing, analyzing, or addressing one concern after another until you lose touch with the original goal. On the other side, you may dismiss their input before fully considering it because receiving guidance feels uncomfortable or limiting.
advice: Discipline is useful when it helps you move forward. It is a problem when it becomes an excuse to do nothing.
summaryShort: Their discipline and your drive build well.
